title: A payment requirement can change the architecture

rows:
Define replay handling and
a durable deduplication record

Separate resource creation from
completion of the business payment
A partner sees only its payments

Enforce access for the requested
object and the caller context

Measure peak demand and agree
capacity and recovery behaviour

Load tests and failure
recovery evidence

elements.text: Illustrative choices to validate, rather than facts about the client implementation.

notes:
APIOps introduction. Technical continuation is illustrative; no client implementation or measured improvement is claimed.

Proposed architecture decisions for the fictional supplier-payment continuation. Idempotency scope, retention, conflict handling and recovery remain decisions to validate. A successful HTTP creation response does not establish completion of the underlying payment. Object-level access control requires implementation and tests.
